vendors.name: WorkOS
vendors.offering: Enterprise SSO and Directory Sync (SCIM) APIs for B2B SaaS developers
vendors.pricing: Per connection: $125/mo for connections 1-15, falling to $65 at 51-100; SSO and SCIM billed as separate connections

vendors.name: Stytch
vendors.offering: B2B auth platform with SSO and SCIM connections from one shared pool
vendors.pricing: 5 SSO/SCIM connections free, then $125 per connection/month; Enterprise custom

vendors.name: SSOJet
vendors.offering: Low-cost enterprise SSO and SCIM layer for SaaS apps
vendors.pricing: Business plan from $118/mo billed annually for 2 connections (SSO and SCIM each count as one)

vendors.name: Ory Polis (formerly BoxyHQ SAML Jackson)
vendors.offering: Open-source enterprise SSO and SCIM 2.0 directory sync, self-host or managed
vendors.pricing: Open source self-hosted; managed/enterprise usage-based, price not public

vendors.name: Auth0 (Okta)
vendors.offering: CIAM platform with B2B enterprise connections and inbound SCIM
vendors.pricing: Free B2B tier includes 1 SSO connection plus SCIM (Feb 2026); B2B Essentials from $150/mo at 500 MAU; extra connections $100/mo

vendors.name: Clerk
vendors.offering: Developer auth platform bundling SCIM with enterprise connections
vendors.pricing: Pro $25/mo with one enterprise connection; SCIM bundled at no extra charge (vendor-authored source)

vendors.name: Stitchflow
vendors.offering: Provisions apps lacking SCIM via browser automation tied to Okta/Entra
vendors.pricing: Vendor claims under $5K per app per year; list price not public

vendors.name: Okta Lifecycle Management
vendors.offering: IdP-side automated provisioning/deprovisioning to SCIM-enabled apps
vendors.pricing: $4 per user per month add-on (bundled in Essentials suite from $17/user/month)

paid_market_gaps.gap: App buyers: 42-43% of 721 SaaS apps lock SCIM behind enterprise tiers; 57% offer no SCIM at all
Per-connection pricing bills SSO and SCIM separately, ~$250/mo per enterprise customer, painful for low-ACV SaaS
Okta customers must buy a $4/user/month Lifecycle Management add-on before SCIM provisioning works
Self-hosted/open-source auth stacks (SuperTokens, FusionAuth, better-auth) still lack native SCIM support

wtp_evidence: SaaS developers pay published per-connection prices ($59-$125/mo) to WorkOS, Stytch, SSOJet; IT buyers pay enterprise upgrades or Okta's $4/user add-on, but resent the SSO/SCIM tax.
bundling_note: Auth platforms now give SCIM away (Auth0 free B2B tier with SCIM, Clerk bundles it on Pro), compressing standalone SCIM-as-a-service pricing toward zero.
summary: Developer-side SCIM is crowded and being bundled free by Auth0/Clerk; little room. A narrower opening: buyer-side provisioning for apps without SCIM or with enterprise-locked SCIM (Stitchflow's niche), sold to mid-market IT teams.
